tools.name: check_domain_availability
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to know if a domain name is available or taken, or asks "can I get <name>". Accepts a full domain ("acme.io") for one verdict, or a bare name ("acme") to check it across popular TLDs (com, io, ai, co, app, dev, net, org, xyz) or a custom TLD list. Checks live DNS, regist

tools.name: suggest_tld_alternatives
tools.description: Use this when the domain the user wants is taken (or they ask for other options for a name). Given a full domain like "acme.com", proposes other endings (acme.io), added words (getacme.com), domain hacks and related words, checks every candidate live, and returns only the ones that are not taken. tools.description: Use this when the user asks what a domain extension costs, where it is cheapest, or what it renews at.
